title: James McDonnell's search for 'gremlins' in his planes

tellings.quote: He would call them gremlins. And so he spent a lot of his research career looking for ghosts in the machine.

plain: James McDonnell, of the aircraft maker McDonnell Douglas, is said to have spent much of his research career hunting for what he called "gremlins" in his planes, unexplained "ghosts in the machine". Michels tells it himself without naming a source, in a conversation with a fighter pilot, and does not say what the gremlins were.
